root.label: Preprocessor and phases
root.note: Nine translation phases; macros rewrite tokens in phase 4, before any C++ meaning exists.

children.label: Early phases
children.note: Phases 1 to 3 turn bytes into preprocessing tokens.

children.label: Phase 1 mapping
children.note: UTF-8 input must be supported since C++23; trigraphs were removed in C++17.

children.label: Phase 2 splicing
children.note: Backslash then newline is deleted; C++23 allows whitespace in between.

children.label: Comment splice trap
children.note: A // comment ending in a backslash swallows the next line.

children.label: Raw strings
children.note: Line splicing is reverted between the quotes of a raw string literal.

children.label: Tokenization
children.note: Phase 3 takes the longest possible preprocessing token each time.

children.label: Maximal munch
children.note: x+++++y is x++ ++ + y and fails; 0xE+1 is a single invalid pp-number.

children.label: Exceptions
children.note: <:: before a non-colon is < then ::, and >> may close two template lists (C++11).

children.label: Digraphs
children.note: <: :> <% %> %: %:%: are real tokens for [ ] { } # ##.

children.label: Comments
children.note: Each comment becomes one space, so it can never paste tokens.

children.label: Macro expansion
children.note: Token substitution followed by rescanning, with recursion blocked.

children.label: Argument pre-expansion
children.note: Arguments are fully expanded first unless they are operands of # or ##.

children.label: # and ##
children.note: # makes a string literal from an argument; ## pastes two tokens into one valid token.

children.label: Painted blue
children.note: A macro name met inside its own expansion is never replaced, then or later.

children.label: Needs a parenthesis
children.note: A function-like macro name not followed by ( is left alone, as in (max)(a, b).

children.label: __VA_OPT__ (C++20)
children.note: Expands its tokens only when variadic arguments are present.

children.label: Directives
children.note: Inclusion and conditional compilation, evaluated in phase 4.

children.label: #include forms
children.note: <h> and "h" search implementation-defined places; a macro form must expand to one of them.

children.label: #if arithmetic
children.note: Done in intmax_t or uintmax_t; leftover identifiers are 0, true is 1.

children.label: Detection
children.note: __has_include (C++17) and __has_cpp_attribute (C++20) work inside #if.

children.label: C++23 additions
children.note: #elifdef, #elifndef and #warning.

children.label: #embed (C++26)
children.note: Expands a resource's bytes to a comma-separated list of integers.

children.label: Predefined macros
children.note: A short standard list plus feature-test macros.

children.label: __func__
children.note: A function-local variable, not a macro; its contents are implementation-defined.

children.label: Feature tests
children.note: __cpp_x for language, __cpp_lib_x from <version>; compare with >=.
